_meta.description: Screening Scope 1+2 emission intensity (tCO2e per $M of REVENUE) for the low-disclosure estimation path (estimation.py). Distinct from sector_taxonomy.emission_intensity_t_per_revenue, which is an EEIO gross-output intensity tuned for the Layer-3 sector shock and undershoots a heavy producer's own footprint. These values are calibrated to real large-cap firms' reported Scope 1+2 ÷ revenue, so an opaque entity's estimate is closer to reality. Screening only — a firm's actual value varies a lot with product mix, integration and geography.
_meta.basis: reported Scope 1+2 (tCO2e) / annual revenue (USD), FY2022-2023, from company disclosures
_meta.fallback: sectors not listed here use sector_taxonomy.emission_intensity_t_per_revenue × 1.15 (add a Scope-2 uplift).

financed_emissions_t_per_musd_revenue._note: FINANCED emissions (Scope 3 cat 15) per $M revenue, for lenders/investors whose material transition exposure is their book, not their offices. Very rough screening scale — real figures need PCAF portfolio data. Anchor: HSBC oil&gas book alone 35.8 Mt on ~$66bn revenue; total financed emissions across all sectors are far larger (O(100s) Mt).

anchors.metals_mining: diversified miners' direct Scope 1+2 per revenue (diesel/processing)
